annotations.shape: one text/plain us-ascii message whose Date zone token is -0000 (RFC 5322: no local time is known); it is never read as +0000
annotations.phase_0_facts: container.*, headers.fields, part.tree, part.regions, part.gaps, body.preamble_epilogue, decode.chain and body.content_sha256 are what the skeleton walker measures today
annotations.phase_1_facts: headers.date: the zone state is zone_stated_minus_zero with the offset token '-0000'; the UTC instant is the same instant a +0000 would give only because there is no local-time information to apply, and the STATE is what a reader must not lose (D2)
annotations.labels_are_typed: every value was read out of the fixture bytes with a hex-editor-style line dump and typed by a model from the RFC and design rules (D2/D9, RFC 5322 3.3), never copied out of the walker; labels_provenance is spec because a model wrote them, not a person
annotations.span_conventions: a field's raw_span covers its line including the line ending; value_span starts immediately after the colon and keeps the leading space; a part's headers_span includes its closing empty line
annotations.expected_gaps: none: -0000 is a legal zone token and is recorded, never repaired
annotations.not_yet_labelled: addresses, encoded words, body views, attachments, statuses, thread edges and TimeEvents
